open_questions: NEXT UNIT: run's apply stage writes a composition (index.html, package.json, vite.config.ts) while migrate --materialize writes the full tree including package-lock.json, so install.lockfile-absent is unreachable-past on every run-composed lane regardless of declarations. Is the fix to materialize under run, to teach install to read the source frontend's lockfile, or to accept that run composes and install replays a closure it must be handed? Until that is decided the fleet cannot get past stage 7 and the three T004 install policies remain untested against a real CRA closure.

cra-redux and your_spotify ship yarn.lock only; the install stage reads npm lockfiles exclusively, so those two will hit a second wall (foreign lockfile) even after the materialize question is settled.
